key.name: active-window-opacity
key.description: Focused window opacity percentage, from 5% (mostly transparent) to 100% (completely opaque).

key.name: inactive-window-opacity
key.description: Inactive windows opacity percentage, from 5% (mostly transparent) to 100% (completely opaque).

key.name: window-filter
key.description: Comma-separated list of WM class names to apply transparency to. Leave empty to apply to all windows.
